About us

Stitching confidence, one blouse at a time

At BlouseBee, we believe every woman deserves a blouse that fits perfectly, reflects her style, and arrives without the stress of endless tailor visits. ♥

🎁 Doorstep pickup and delivery📏 Custom fit with video support⏱️ 72-hour express delivery🏅 Premium quality finishing

Our story

BlouseBee was born from a simple observation: finding a reliable tailor is often difficult.

For customers

Poor fitting, repeated alterations, delays, inconsistent quality and limited customisation are all too common.


For tailors

Thousands of talented women tailors struggle with irregular work and limited access to customers.


BlouseBee bridges this gap by combining technology with skilled craftsmanship, creating a seamless tailoring experience for customers and sustainable livelihoods for women artisans.

End-to-end customised blouse stitching with premium finishing.

How BlouseBee works

Five steps from booking to a blouse you can wear.

  1. BookMessage us on WhatsApp, call, or use the website.
  2. Home measurement and fabric pickupOur expert visits you, takes measurements and collects your fabric. Outside our cities, we guide you over a video call.
  3. Matched to a verified tailorA skilled woman tailor is assigned to your design.
  4. Digital blueprint and quality checkYour measurements become a digital pattern, and every blouse passes quality control.
  5. Doorstep deliveryYour perfect-fit blouse arrives at your home.

Terms and conditions

Draft for review. Please check the timelines, fees and policies below against how BlouseBee actually operates, and have them reviewed by a lawyer before publishing.

1. About these terms

These terms apply to all orders placed with BlouseBee through WhatsApp, phone, our website or Instagram. By placing an order, you agree to them.

2. Services and rates

  • Rates are listed on our Services and rate card page. Prices marked "onward" are starting prices and depend on design, fabric and amount of work.
  • The final price is confirmed with you at or before measurement, before work begins.
  • Fabric is supplied by the customer unless agreed otherwise.

3. Booking and measurement

  • Home measurement visits are available in our active service areas. Elsewhere, we offer video measurement support.
  • Please share accurate details of your design and fabric. Measurements we take or guide you through are used to create your digital blueprint.
  • Please be available at the agreed time. We may ask to reschedule if you are not.

4. Payment

  • An advance may be requested to confirm your order. The balance is due on delivery or as agreed with you.
  • Payment methods accepted will be shared at the time of booking.

5. Timelines and delivery

  • We give an expected delivery date when your order is confirmed. Complex work such as Aari work and bridal blouses takes longer.
  • Delays can happen from fabric issues, design changes or festive demand. We will tell you early and keep you updated.
  • Delivery is available in Pune and PCMC.

6. Fit guarantee, trials and alterations

  • Our Perfect Fit Guarantee covers blouses made to the measurements taken or confirmed by BlouseBee. If the fit is off, tell us within the period stated at delivery and we will correct it.
  • The Bridal package includes 2 trial fittings. Other orders include trials only if agreed.
  • Changes to design or measurements after stitching has started may cost extra and delay delivery.
  • Fit issues caused by measurements the customer supplied themselves, or by weight changes after measurement, may be charged as alterations.

7. Fabric and materials

  • Please tell us about delicate, stretchy or heavily embroidered fabrics. These may need special handling.
  • We take every care with your fabric. We cannot be held responsible for flaws already in the fabric, or for colour bleeding, shrinkage or damage caused by the fabric's own nature.
  • Please keep a record of the fabric you hand over. We will confirm quantity at pickup.

8. Cancellations and refunds

  • You can cancel before stitching begins for a full refund of any advance, less any measurement visit costs where applicable.
  • Once cutting or stitching has started, custom-made work cannot be cancelled or refunded. We will work with you to put right any genuine defect.

9. Our tailors and quality

Orders are stitched by verified tailors in the BlouseBee network and pass quality control before delivery. Please do not contact or pay our tailors directly for BlouseBee orders.

10. Privacy

We use your name, contact details, address and measurements only to deliver your order and improve our service. We do not sell your personal information. Photos or videos you share for measurement are used only for that purpose.

11. Liability

Our liability for any order is limited to the amount you paid for it. We are not liable for indirect losses, such as a missed event, unless we have agreed a delivery date in writing.

12. Changes and contact

We may update these terms from time to time. The version on this page applies to new orders. Questions? Call or WhatsApp +91 9960466405.
